items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: He was the conductor. He fronted the band...

ctx.x: Bardu Ali, he was a singer, what -

He was the conductor. He fronted the band... I was going to leave and he said, "Well, my boy, why don't you stay and stick it out?" I said, "Well, Basie's here, he can get anything he wants." We developed a friendship and the man gave me some secrets that I could never divulge because I wouldn't know who to impart them to, evento my own son. I have never known the discussions I had with him. When he found out about my musical background; and what people did not know, this man was very musical. In later years…
